raw_text:
{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/ base, txindex, blockfilterindex, coinstatsindex, and txospenderindex files to alter error handling on corrupt reads.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents secondary indexes from silently treating corrupted database records as non-existent keys. As the author notes, previously 'a corrupt txindex point read can consequently fail one RPC while the node continues running' with damaged state."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainstatemanager_opts.h (+3/-0) to pass the fatal error callback.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The three-line modification to chainstatemanager_opts.h mechanically plumbs the fatal-error callback through chainstate options without substantively changing the kernel boundary or API architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h (+1/-1 each).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to txmempool are mechanical call-site adjustments following changes to the coin view interface."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds test/functional/feature_coinsdb_read_error.py and updates coins fuzz harnesses.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional and fuzz test additions specifically exercise UTXO and dbwrapper read failure handling rather than modifying test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp (+15/-12) and src/dbwrapper.cpp/h.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The database wrapper is part of validation storage by definition, and init.cpp edits merely wire the application-level fatal error callback."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies src/coins.*, src/txdb.*, src/dbwrapper.*, and src/node/chainstate.*.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a chainstate integrity hazard where LevelDB deserialization failures were reported as missing keys instead of fatal errors. It also removes the CCoinsViewErrorCatcher wrapper layer, eliminating unnecessary indirection across the coins view stack."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
